response.rationale: Concept A (OrderLine) and Concept B (Order) represent distinct business concepts in a part-whole (composition) relationship rather than the same concept under different names. In src/ordering/domain/order.ts (node 99595122f2958507), an Order contains a collection of OrderLine items (`readonly lines: readonly OrderLine[],`) and aggregates each line's price and quantity (`return this.lines.reduce((acc, l) => acc + l.price * l.quantity, 0);`), while in src/notifications/application/order-notification.service.ts (node ee110f001f97012a), OrderNotificationService operates on the aggregate Order (`const subtotal = order.subtotal();`).
